headline: An Ecologic Study of Poliomyelitis in Connecticut, 1931-1941
source: Yale Journal of Biology and Medicine (via PubMed Central)
blurb: This journal article from May 1943 is a study of polio in Connecticut over the years 1931 to 1941.

headline: Poliomyelitis — Connecticut
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report (via CDC Stacks)
blurb: On October 25, 1972, three cases of paralytic polio in students at a private school in Greenwich were reported, with eight more cases of paralytic illness under investigation, and a vaccination program was held at the school the next day.

headline: Early Childhood Vaccination Levels Among Urban Children -- Connecticut, 1990 and 1991
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A review of first graders' school records in Hartford and New Haven in 1990 and 1991 found that 67.2% and 70.8% of the children had finished the vaccines required for school by their second birthday.

headline: AN ACT CONCERNING IMMUNIZATIONS.
source: Connecticut General Assembly, Public Act No. 21-6
blurb: This Connecticut law, approved on April 28, 2021, removed the religious exemption from the vaccines required to enroll in school.

headline: Attorney General Tong Statement on U.S. Supreme Court Denial of Cert in Case Challenging Connecticut School Vaccine Requirements
source: Connecticut Office of the Attorney General
blurb: The U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear a challenge to the 2021 Connecticut law that ended the religious exemption from school vaccine requirements, the state attorney general's office said.

headline: Connecticut reports first case of measles in years
blurb: The Connecticut Department of Public Health confirmed measles in an unvaccinated Fairfield County child under 10 who had recently traveled abroad, the state's first case in more than four years.
